name: Staff of Nat Gann
upgradeable: Epic Crafting to Epic Staff of Nat Gann

effects.name: Enhancement Bonus
effects.tooltip: +2 Enhancement Bonus : +2 enhancement bonus to attack and damage rolls .

effects.name: Dexterity
effects.tooltip: Dexterity +3 : This item makes the wearer more nimble and dexterous, granting a +3 Enhancement bonus to Dexterity.

effects.name: Deception
effects.tooltip: Deception +2 : +2 Enhancement bonus to hit and +3 to damage for any hit that would qualify as a sneak attack.

effects.name: Silver , Alchemical
effects.tooltip: Silver : A complex process involving metallurgy and alchemy can bond silver to a weapon made of steel so that it bypasses the damage reduction of creatures such as devils and vampires. Silver weapons have 2 points lower hardness then equivalent steel weapons, and as such aren't quite as durable.

flavor_text: This weapon belonged to the famed performer Nat Gann. Though he remains lost to time, his staff lives on in his memory, and is an ideal tool for the aspiring acrobat.
